# Champion charter

Use this to agree on what a champion does, what they do not do, and how much time it takes. The champion and their manager should both agree. Program design is in `docs/02-enable.md`.

## Purpose

Why this team has a champion, in one sentence: [fill in]

## What the champion does

- Helps colleagues with their first real task.
- Shares tested prompts, rules and commands in the team channel.
- Attends the champion sync and reports blockers.
- Helps with office hours: [fill in how often].
- Gives honest feedback on what does not work.

## What the champion does not do

- Act as a help desk or on-call contact for the tool.
- Review every agent-made change for the team.
- Chase colleagues about usage numbers.
- Report on individuals to managers.
- Make security or privacy decisions.
